chapter.verse: Zeisu in hih bangin thu a nget khit ciangin, a nungzuite tawh tua mun nusia-in Kidron Kuam a kantan uh hi. Tua kuam galkhat ah Oliv huan khat a om hi; tua huan sungah amah leh a nungzuite a lut uh hi.
Amah a lehheekpa Judas in zong tua mun a thei hi. Bang hang hiam i cih leh, Zeisu leh a nungzuite in tuasan takah tamveipi a pai uh hi.
Tua lai takin Judas in galkap pawlkhat tawh, siampi liante leh Farisaite’ paisak palik mangte tawh a kipawl khit ciangin, meivak, meilah leh hiamte tawi-in tua munah a pai uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Zeisu in ama tungah a piang ding thu khempeuh thei ahih ciangin paikhia a, “Note in kua zong na hi uh hiam?” ci-in a dong hi.
Amaute in, “Nazareth mi Zeisu ka zong uh hi,” a cih uh leh, “Kei tua pa ka hi hi,” a ci hi. A lehheekpa Judas in amaute tawh a ding khawm hi.
Tua lai takin Zeisu in, “Kei tua pa ka hi hi,” ci-in a gen ciangin amaute nunglamah kin uh a, lei ah a puk uh hi.
Tua ciangin Zeisu in, “Note in kua zong na hi uh hiam?” ci-in a dot kik leh, amaute in, “Nazareth mi Zeisu ka zong uh hi,” a ci uh hi.
Zeisu in, “Kei tua pa ka hi hi kong ci zo hi,” a ci hi.
‘Kei na hong piak mite khat beek a mangthang kei hi,’ a cihna thu a tun’ nadingin Zeisu in, “Kei hong zong na hih uh leh, hih mite paikhia ta hen!” a ci hi.
Tua lai takin Simon Piter in a namsau puak a dawh khit ciangin, siampi ukpa’ silapa sat a, a taklam bil a satkhia hi. Tua silapa min in Malkhas ahi hi.
Tua lai takin Zeisu in Piter kiangah, “Namsau a pai sungah siat kik in. Pa in kei hong piak hai dawn lo ding ka hi hiam?” ci-in a gen hi.
Tua lai takin galkapte akipan galkap mangpa leh Judah upa nasemte in Zeisu a man uh a; khau tawh a hen khit uh ciangin,
Annas kiangah a paipih masa uh hi. Bang hang hiam i cih leh, Annas in tua kuma siampi ukpa Kai-afas’ sungpa ahi hi.
Tua Kai-afas in, “Mite tangdingin mi khat a sih leh a pha hi,” ci-a Judah mite tawh a vaihawmpa ahi hi.
Simon Piter leh adang nungzuite khat in Zeisu nung a zui uh hi. Tua nungzuipa in siampi ukpa tawh kimeeltheih a, Zeisu tawh siampi ukpa’ inn tualah a lut khawm hi.
Ahih hangin Piter in pualam kongpi kiangah a ding hi. Tua ahih ciangin siampi ukpa tawh a kimeeltheih nungzuipa paikhia a, kongpi a cing numei kiangah a gen khit ciangin Piter a lutsak hi.
Tua lai takin kongpi a cing numei in, “Nang hih mi’ nungzui khat hilo na hi hiam?” a cih ciangin, “Ka hi kei hi,” a ci hi.
Tua lai takin silate leh nasemte in meiphual cih uh a, tuasan takah mei awi-in a ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam i cih leh, khua a dam hi. Piter zong amaute tawh omkhawm a, ding-in mei a awi hi.
Tua ahih ciangin siampi ukpa in ama nungzuite leh ama thuhilhna thu Zeisu kiangah a dong hi.
Zeisu in, “Leitung mite mai-ah a kilangin ka gen zo hi. Judah mite’ kikhopna innte leh biakna innpi sungah a tawntungin thu ka hilh a, thu ka hilhsim ngei kei hi.
Bang dingin kei hong dong na hi hiam? Ka thu hong zate kiangah bang thu ka gen cih na dong in. Ka thugenna amaute in a thei ding uh hi,” ci-in a dawng hi.
Tua bangin a dawn’ ciangin, a kianga ding nasemte khat in, “Tua bangin siampi ukpa na dawngkik hiam?” ci-in a khut tawh Zeisu a beeng hi.
Zeisu in, “Aman lo ka gen leh, aman lohna hong lak in. Aman ka gen leh bang hangin hong beeng na hi hiam?” ci-in a dawng kik hi.
Tua ciangin Annas in siampi ukpa Kai-afas kiangah kihensa-in Zeisu a paisak hi.
Tua lai takin Simon Piter ding a, mei a awi lai takin amaute in, “Nang Zeisu a nungzui khat hilo na hi hiam?” ci-in a dot uh ciangin, “Ka hi kei hi,” ci-in a nial hi.
Piter in a bil a satpa tawh a kibeh, siampi ukpa’ sila khat in Piter kiangah, “Nang Zeisu tawh huan sungah hong mu hilo ka hi hiam?” a cih ciangin,
Piter in a nial kik hi. Tua ciangin thakhatin aak a khuang hi.

Tua ahih ciangin amau in Kai-afas kiang pan mang innah a paipih uh hi. Tua laitak in zingsang tung ahi hi. Amaute in Paisan pawi a nek theih nadingun kisian’suah nuam uh ahih manin mang inn sungah a tum kei uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Pilat in amaute kiangah paikhia a, “Hih mi’ tungah mawhsakna bang na nei uh hiam?” ci-in a dong hi.
Amaute in, “Hih pa migilo hi kei leh, nang kiangah kong pia kei ding uh hi,” a ci uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Pilat in, “Hih pa la un la, note ngeina bangin thu na khen un,” a ci hi. Judah mite in, “Kote in mi thah theih nading thu ka nei kei uh hi,” a ci uh hi.
Tua bang a cihna in, Zeisu in bangci a sih ding ci-in lim lak a, a genkholh mah bangin a tun’ nading ahi hi.
Pilat mang inn sungah a lut khit ciangin Zeisu sam a, “Nang Judah Kumpipa na hi hiam?” ci-in a dong hi.
Zeisu in, “Nangma ut bangin hih bangin hong dong na hi hiam? Ahih kei leh, midangte in keima thu hong gen zo ahi hiam?” ci-in a dawng hi.
Pilat in, “Judah mi na hi hiam? Nangma mipawlte leh siampi liante in nang kei khut sungah hong pia uh hi. Nang in bang hih khial na hi hiam?” ci-in a dot ciangin,

Zeisu in, “Keima gam in leitung gam ahi kei hi. Keima gam in leitung gam hi leh, Judah mite khut sung ka tun’ loh nading ka mite in a do ding uh hi. Tu-in, ka gam in hih lai takah a om kei hi,” a ci hi.

Pilat in, “Tua bang ahih leh, nang Kumpipa na hi hiam?” ci-in a dot ciangin Zeisu in, “Kumpipa na hi nong ci hi. Kei ka hih leh, thuman thutak ading teci pang dingin ah leitungah kong kum a, kong suak hi. Thuman thutak a deih mi khempeuh in keima’ aw a ngai uh hi,” ci-in a gen hi.
Pilat in, “Thuman thutak bang ahi hiam?” a ci hi. Tua thu a gen khit ciangin Judah mite kiangah paikhia a, “Hih mi tungah mawhna ka mu kei hi.
Ahih hangin Paisan Pawi khamna-ah mi khat no kiangah ka khah ding ngeina khat a om hi. Tua ahih ciangin no kiangah Judahte’ Kumpipa ka khah ding nong awi uh hiam?” a ci hi.
Amaute in, “Hih mi khah ding ka deih kei uh hi; Barabbas na khah ding ka deih uh hi,” ci-in nakpi-in kiko kikin a ngen uh hi. Barabbas in misuampa ahi hi.
